findings.title: The revision layer is gated on the QUERY's wording, not the data
findings.status: reported, not fixed -- changing it is a ranking change
findings.condition: intent is not None or is_personal_query(q) or has_temporal_cue(q)
findings.effect: a third-person query never engages the entity/revision layer, so search falls back to raw cosine over the revision chain and can return a superseded value as current, with no error

single_chain_probe.note: the correct answer has the LOWEST cosine of the four

findings.workaround: include a temporal cue ('current', 'now', 'latest') or set intent

findings.title: Retention treats the chunks of one long value as separate revisions
findings.cause: add() splits a long record into {parent}_chunk_N and every chunk inherits `entity`, so N chunks of one version looked like N revisions

before.forget_superseded_keep1: 3-version refund policy: 12 records -> 1; survivor was boilerplate; 'eligibility window is 90 days' GONE
before.never_revised_document: a policy written ONCE, never revised: forget_superseded(keep=1, min_revisions=2) deleted 2 of its 3 chunks

use_case_verdicts.A_config_drift: viable with the cue; sibling retrieval 100% top-1 (bar 80)
use_case_verdicts.B_price_tracking: viable; SKU top-1 100% (bar 70) -- prediction of failure was WRONG
use_case_verdicts.C_multi_tenant: viable WITH filter=; 0 leaks in 30 probes. Without filter, 100 of 150 returned rows belonged to other tenants
use_case_verdicts.D_agent_task_state: viable as shipped; 2-second revisions ordered correctly, rate rendered '2s'
use_case_verdicts.E_policy_versioning: viable with the cue AND 0.7.3; was destroying documents before
use_case_verdicts.F_entity_scale: 5,000 entities / 15,000 records: as_of 100% with cue; median filtered search 39.23 ms, p95 53.35 ms -- MISSES the 25 ms bar

correct: A1/B1/D1/E1 are sort-and-filter (right that they are mechanical, wrong that they pass as shipped)
C1 passes, C2 is the finding
wrong: B2 predicted to FAIL at 70% -- measured 100%. nomic-embed-text separates 200 template-identical SKUs cleanly
A1/E1/F1 predicted to pass -- measured 52-67%, and the cause was named by no prediction
